title: I Went to the Woods: The weight of waiting
description: I had arrived at the moment of fleeting clarity. The boat ramp ended where the bottom flattened and with 160 pounds of concrete, my skiff would not float clear of the trailer. I pushed to no avail. Do I back out, cut my losses and wait for the tide to continue to drop, pause, then rise? That would be two more hours. I was ready to get out to our lot and start some real construction on our remote cabin.
